customH2Sections.title: Make a music video from an MP3, WAV or Suno track
customH2Sections.body: Upload your finished song or paste a supported music link. Revid uses that recording as the soundtrack while it builds the visuals. Use the audio trim control to start with a chorus or a short release teaser, or keep the full track selected. For a Suno song, provide the share link or upload the audio file you downloaded. Choose the output ratio for your destination before generating: vertical for a short social clip or landscape for a YouTube music video.

customH2Sections.title: Choose beat sync for instrumentals or lyric timing for vocals
customH2Sections.body: The generator has separate Lyrics and Beats timing options. Choose Beats when you want visuals paced to an instrumental, dance track or beat. Choose Lyrics when the words should guide the scenes, then review the detected lyrics and caption timing in the editor. A dense mix or an unusual pronunciation can need corrections. Singer lip sync is a separate option for shots where an on-screen performer should sing; it is different from putting lyric captions over a scene.

customH2Sections.title: Plan the visuals before generating a full song
customH2Sections.body: Pick a subject, a setting and a visual style that can carry several scenes. For a night-drive track, a direction like 'a lone driver, wet city streets, blue reflections, slow tracking shots' gives the visuals a consistent starting point. Try a short excerpt first so you can judge the pacing and look before spending credits on the full song. AI video, moving images and stock footage produce different results and have different credit costs; check the estimate shown before generation.

customH2Sections.title: Review the scenes, captions and ending before export
customH2Sections.body: Open the generated video in the browser editor and watch it with the original track. Replace a scene that does not fit the lyric, adjust a cut that interrupts a phrase, and correct names or words in the captions. Keep text away from the edges for mobile viewing. Check the last shot as carefully as the first: a held final frame can suit a sustained note better than an abrupt cut. Export the finished video, or use Revid's publishing tools when you are ready to post.

showcaseVideos.title: Maybe That’s Enough
showcaseVideos.description:
## Songs About Self Acceptance and Letting Go of Expectations When everyday life feels like an endless loop of unmet expectations, it is easy to feel overwhelmed by the pressure to have everything figured out. "Maybe That's Enough" touches on the quiet realization that simply existing and getting through the day can be plenty. This lyrical music video reflects on the weight of trying to fit into everyone else's mold while searching for personal peace. Whether you are dealing with burnout, quiet doubts, or just need a gentle reminder to slow down, the track offers an honest look at self-compassion. Here is what makes this piece resonate: * An honest look at the exhausting cycle of putting off peace until "tomorrow"
* Themes of letting go of other people's versions and expectations of who you should be
* The quiet victory of finding spontaneous joy in small, unexpected moments
* Minimal, reflective audio and visuals designed to give you space to breathe Take a moment to step back from the noise and remember that you do not need all the answers right now.

creationParams.prompt: A charming stop-motion clay adventure following a small, expressive clay character on a journey through a handcrafted miniature world.

creationParams.visualDirection:
Pixar and Disney feature animation style 3D CGI. Smooth matte poreless
skin, simplified rounded facial forms, large glossy expressive eyes, soft
clay-like surfaces. NOT photorealistic, no live action, no real people,
no skin pores, no fine wrinkles.

All characters are Black, except brief biblical vision shots. Main
character is a 45-year-old Black woman with a shoulder-length dark brown
twist-out, gold hoop earrings and a thin gold cross necklace. Her younger
sister is 36 with long box braids in a low bun. Same faces in every shot.

Warm golden color palette. Soft global illumination, warm practical light
sources, shallow depth of field. Golden light through stained glass in
church interiors. Single warm lamp in night interiors. Bright open
morning light in kitchen scenes.

9:16 vertical. Slow camera moves only — gentle push-ins and drifts. No
fast cuts, no handheld, no camera shake. Subject centered with clear
empty space in the lower third of frame.

No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks anywhere in frame.
creationParams.prompt:
Pixar-style 3D animation. A 45-year-old Black woman has sat in the same
church pew since childhood but never understood the Bible she carries.
When someone asks what she believes, she freezes. A study guide teaches
her that Paul wrote from prison in chains, and every verse she already
knew hits new. She calls her sister with the whole story. Ends in that
same pew, same seat, different woman. Warm stained-glass light, intimate
night interiors, vision shots of Paul in chains and David in the rain.

creationParams.visualDirection:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action concert cinematography.
Create an original vocalist who does not resemble Olivia Dean or another identifiable performer.
Maintain exactly the same protagonist face, natural hairstyle, ivory suit, champagne top, jewellery, shoes and body proportions throughout.
Preserve the same stage, theatre architecture, microphone, musicians and instrument arrangement throughout the full video.
Use an intimate restored theatre rather than a stadium, nightclub, festival field or television studio.
Visual atmosphere inspired by classic soul performances, contemporary live sessions and elegant analogue concert films.
Deep burgundy curtains, red velvet seating, dark wood, brushed brass, cream plaster and warm tungsten stage lights.
No LED wall, projected lyrics, digital graphics, lasers, pyrotechnics, smoke cannons or oversized concert effects.
Use light atmospheric haze only to make stage beams and depth visible.
Warm amber and soft gold lighting contrasted with deeper burgundy shadows.
Keep skin tones natural and richly rendered.
Realistic skin pores, subtle perspiration, individual hair strands, natural facial asymmetry and physically accurate eye reflections.
Maintain precise lip-sync between the vocalist and the supplied track.
Mouth movement must remain anatomically natural, with accurate jaw, cheek, tongue and breath behaviour.
Avoid excessive mouth opening, warped teeth, changing facial structure or generic looping singing animation.
Show believable breathing before and between vocal phrases.
The vocalist must sing primarily toward the room and microphone rather than constantly performing directly into the camera.
Use emotionally restrained facial acting.
No exaggerated crying, seductive posing, angry gestures or melodramatic expressions.
Movement should build progressively with the arrangement: stillness, subtle rhythm, confident stage movement, then a fuller final performance.
creationParams.prompt: Create a cinematic live stage performance inside an intimate restored theatre. An original young Black female vocalist in a tailored ivory suit performs with a compact soul band: drums, bass, guitar, keys, brass and two backing singers. Begin behind closed burgundy curtains as they slowly part, revealing her alone beneath one warm spotlight at a vintage chrome microphone. Keep the opening restrained, with subtle breathing, precise lip-sync and minimal movement. As the song builds, amber lights gradually reveal the musicians and front rows of the audience. She steps away from the stand and moves with relaxed confidence while the band responds naturally. During the quieter section, isolate her near the stage edge in a narrow spotlight. For the final chorus, the brass rises, backing singers step forward and the audience gradually stands and dances. End as she returns to the microphone, the camera pulls back through the theatre, the final note fades and applause fills the room.

item1.title: How can Revid.ai transform my content creation game?
item1.description: Revid turns a prompt, script, link, product page, audio file, or PDF into an editable video workflow. It can draft the script, generate or source visuals, add voice and captions, and prepare the result for social publishing.

item2.title: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
item2.description: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You can do so by going to your account settings. And if you need help with anything, our (human) support team is here to assist you.

item3.title: Do I own the content created?
item3.description: Yes, 100%! You own all the content you create with Revid.ai, forever. Every video, script, and asset generated through our platform belongs entirely to you. There are no hidden clauses or shared ownership - your creative work is yours to use, modify, and monetize as you see fit.

item4.title: I'm not a video editing pro. Can I still use Revid.ai?
item4.description: Absolutely! Revid.ai is designed with creators like you in mind. Our intuitive interface and AI-driven tools make it a breeze to produce professional-grade videos, even if you've never edited before. Simply input your text or link, and let our AI work its magic. It's like having a video editing genius at your fingertips! Most users master the basics in less than 5 minutes.

item5.title: What kind of content can I create with Revid.ai?
item5.description: The possibilities are endless! Whether you want to repurpose a blog post, turn a podcast into a video, create a viral TikTok from scratch, or produce engaging product demos and explainer videos, Revid.ai has you covered. Our AI can generate scripts from any text or URL, find the perfect viral hooks, and even create videos automatically from your favorite content sources. If you can dream it, Revid.ai can help you create it.

item6.title: How much control do I have over the AI-generated content?
item6.description: While our AI is incredibly powerful, you always remain in the driver's seat. Revid.ai provides a foundation of high-quality, engaging content that you can then customize to your heart's content. From adding a professional sounding voice-over and branding elements to fine-tuning the visuals and pacing, our platform empowers you to create videos that are authentically yours.

item7.title: How can Revid.ai help me grow my audience and business?
item7.description: Revid helps you test more hooks, formats, stories, and product angles without rebuilding every video from scratch. You can edit each result, publish it to your channels, and use Auto-Mode to keep a repeatable content plan moving. Audience results still depend on the idea, offer, and distribution—no tool can guarantee views.

item8.title: What pricing plans do you offer, and what's included?
item8.description: We offer several flexible subscription plans designed to fit businesses of all sizes. Our most popular plan starts at just $39/month and includes 2,000 credits, access to all premium features, and priority support. To know more about how credits are used, visit <link>our blog post about this topic</link>. All plans come with our AI video generation technology, ready to use tools, and commercial usage rights.

item9.title: How does Revid.ai compare to other video creation tools?
item9.description: Revid combines generation, editing, captions, voice, publishing, automation, API, MCP, and CLI access in one product. Instead of stopping at a generated clip, it gives you an editable project you can adapt for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, product marketing, or automated workflows.

item10.title: Is my data safe with Revid.ai?
item10.description: Absolutely. We take data privacy and security very seriously. Revid.ai employs industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your content and personal information. We never share your data with third parties without your explicit consent. With Revid.ai, you can focus on creating amazing videos while we take care of keeping your data safe and sound.

item11.title: How much time and effort can Revid.ai save me?
item11.description: Revid.ai is like having a full video production team at your beck and call, 24/7. Our AI handles the heavy lifting, from researching viral trends to generating scripts and visuals. What used to take hours or even days can now be accomplished in minutes. And with our Automations feature, you can even set Revid.ai to create videos for you on autopilot. It's the ultimate time-saver for busy creators who don't want to compromise on quality!

item12.title: How does Revid.ai stay ahead of the curve in video creation?
item12.description: Our team of video experts and AI engineers are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. We stay on top of the latest trends, platform updates, and best practices to ensure that Revid.ai remains the cutting-edge tool for creating irresistible videos. As the digital landscape evolves, so does Revid.ai, giving you a competitive edge in your content creation game.

item13.title: What if I need help or have questions?
item13.description: We're here for you every step of the way! Our friendly support team, made up of video experts and creators like you, is always ready to answer your questions, provide guidance, and help you get the most out of Revid.ai. We offer live chat support during business hours.

item14.title: What technical requirements do I need to use Revid.ai?
item14.description: Revid.ai is a cloud-based platform that works in any modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) without requiring any downloads or installations. All you need is a stable internet connection and a computer or tablet. For the best experience, we recommend a connection speed of at least 5 Mbps. Since all the processing happens on our powerful servers, you don't need a high-end device to create stunning videos.

faq.howItWorksTitle: How to transform your music link into an amazing music video with Revid in 3 steps

howItWorks.title: 1. Upload your track
howItWorks.body: Choose your music file - audio or video. The AI handles both formats perfectly. Quality matters here. Better input, better output. Even if your file isn't studio-grade, the AI can still produce impressive results.

howItWorks.title: 2. Select your style
howItWorks.body: Choose your visual preference: stock videos, AI-generated clips, or moving AI images. Each offers unique advantages. Stock is efficient, AI-generated is customized, moving images balance both. Your choice shapes the final product. Select what suits your vision best.

howItWorks.title: 3. Generate and refine
howItWorks.body: Hit 'Generate' and let the AI work its magic. In minutes, you'll have a video. Then, use the editor to enhance. Adjust timings, swap visuals, fine-tune captions. This is where you add your personal touch. Make it uniquely yours.

faq.title: What is the "AI Music Video Generator" tool?
faq.description: The "AI Music Video Generator" tool is a cutting-edge AI video generator designed specifically for music. Users input their music as either audio or video, and the tool generates a complete video with synchronized visuals and captions. Designed for efficiency, it allows artists and content creators to produce professional-quality music videos with minimal time and effort

faq.title: How do i use the AI music video generator tool?
faq.description: AI Music Video Generator follows a three-step process: Input, Generate, Refine. Upload your music, select your visual preferences, and let the AI create your video. Afterward, use our editor to fine-tune the result. The entire process is designed to be intuitive and typically takes just a few minutes, requiring no technical expertise

faq.title: What types of visuals can I choose for my video?
faq.description: We offer four visual options: stock videos, AI-generated videos, moving AI images, and your own media. Stock videos are fast and reliable, using pre-existing footage matched to your music. AI-generated videos create custom visuals for each part of your song, offering higher personalization but using more processing power. Moving AI images animate still pictures, balancing uniqueness and efficiency. Choose based on your priorities: speed, customization, or a middle ground

faq.title: Can I use both audio and video files with this tool?
faq.description: Yes. Upload an MP3, WAV or M4A, paste a Suno link, or upload a video file (MP4, WebM or MOV). With a video, Revid uses its soundtrack as the song: the original footage does not appear in the music video. Every scene is new full-screen visuals in the style you pick, timed to the lyrics or the beat

faq.title: How accurate are the synchronized captions?
faq.description: Our AI is highly effective at generating synchronized captions. It analyzes the audio, identifies the lyrics, and times them to match the music. The results are usually spot-on, especially for clear vocals. However, AI isn't infallible. Complex lyrics or unusual pronunciations can sometimes throw it off. That's why we include an editor - it lets you fine-tune the captions if needed. This combination of AI power and human judgment tends to produce the best results. Most users find they rarely need to make adjustments

faq.title: What is the sound wave option?
faq.description: The sound wave option adds a visual representation of your audio at the bottom of the video. It's a dynamic graphic that moves with your music's rhythm and intensity. In practice, it looks like an oscilloscope display that pulses with the beat. Some users find it adds energy to their videos, making them more engaging. Others prefer a cleaner look without it. There's no right or wrong choice - it's purely an aesthetic decision. We've found it tends to work particularly well for electronic and dance music genres

faq.title: Can i edit the AI generated video?
faq.description: Yes, you can edit the video after generation. Our built-in editor allows you to adjust captions, timing, and add effects. It's designed to be intuitive - you don't need to be a professional video editor to use it effectively. You can tweak colors, adjust transitions, or even add your own images or clips. This editing stage is where you can really put your personal stamp on the video. Some users spend more time here than in the generation phase, fine-tuning every detail

faq.title: What file formats does the tool accept?
faq.description: We accept common audio formats like MP3, WAV, AAC, and M4A. For video, we support MP4, MOV, AVI, and WMV. If your file is in a different format, you may need to convert it before uploading. We recommend using high-quality files for the best results in your generated video. The variety of accepted formats makes the tool accessible for most users' existing media libraries

faq.title: How long does it take to generate a video?
faq.description: Generation typically takes 2 to 5 minutes, depending on your music's length, chosen visual style, and complexity. AI-generated videos may take longer due to their personalized nature. We balance speed and quality to deliver polished videos efficiently. The wait time is usually shorter than brewing a pot of coffee, and certainly faster than traditional video production methods. We're constantly working on optimizing our algorithms to reduce generation time without sacrificing quality. For most users, the time saved compared to manual video creation far outweighs the brief waiting period

faq.title: How long can my song be?
faq.description: Full songs work: Revid builds the music video around the whole track, and you can trim it if you only want one part. The 30 examples on the AI music video maker page run from 37 seconds to 6 minutes 47 seconds. Credits scale with length: AI video costs 15 credits per 5 seconds at Low, 50 at Pro and 100 at Ultra, so a 3-minute song is about 540 credits at Low. The editor shows the cost before anything renders.

faq.title: How does Revid compare with other AI music video generators?
faq.description: We scored 11 AI music video generators on 10 checks a musician needs, each one backed by a page you can open. Revid scored 9 out of 10, Neural Frames 8.5 and Solmi 8, and only 5 of the 11 make a full-length video from one song. The full comparison, with sources: best AI music video generators in 2026.

faq.title: Can I use this tool for commercial purposes?
faq.description: Yes, you can use the videos generated by the AI Music Video Generator tool for commercial purposes, provided you have the necessary rights to the music you're using. This makes the tool valuable for creating promotional content, music videos for your own songs, or enhancing your brand's social media presence. However, ensure you have appropriate licenses for any copyrighted music before using the videos commercially

faq.title: I have an additional question not answered here. How can I get help?
faq.description: We're here to help! If you have any other questions about using the AI Music Video Generator or any other part of Revid.AI, please reach out to our friendly support team. You can contact us via email hello@revid.ai and we'll get back to you ASAP
